summary: 5-day LQMS training course covering ISO 15189:2022, ISO/IEC 17025, CAPA, internal audit, and method validation. Build accreditation-ready QMS skills. Enrol now.
lede: A laboratory quality management system (LQMS) organizes quality controls across laboratory testing workflows. This training is for laboratory professionals responsible for designing, maintaining, or overseeing those systems. Through practical exercises, participants assess gaps, control documents, validate methods, manage corrective actions, plan risk-based audits, and report quality indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for laboratory professionals who carry direct responsibility for quality system design, maintenance, compliance, or oversight across clinical, testing, research, or public health laboratory settings. It suits those with existing laboratory experience who need to formalize, strengthen, or audit their quality management practices.
modules: Laboratory QMS Foundations and Standards Landscape
QMS Gap Analysis and Quality Planning
Method Validation, Verification, and Measurement Uncertainty
Quality Control Design and Proficiency Testing
Management Review, KPI Reporting, and QMS Continual Improvement
prerequisites: This course is designed for intermediate-level laboratory professionals. Participants should have a minimum of two years of practical experience working in a laboratory environment (clinical, testing, research, or public health). A working familiarity with standard laboratory workflows — including pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical phases — is expected. Prior exposure to quality control concepts (e.g., Levey-Jennings charts, control charts, or SOP documentation) is beneficial but not mandatory. No advanced statistical or programming skills are required. Participants should bring a laptop capable of running standard spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel or equivalent) for workshop exercises. Course datasets and document templates are provided.
